title: sebastiania glandulosa f. calvescens

It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including cancer, due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for natural medicine.
